name: agentex
description: AgenTeX: 19 skills + 3 hooks that keep LaTeX papers honest to the code behind them: a desk-rejection gate per venue (page limit, style file, anonymity, checklists, LLM-use disclosure), citations verified against five databases with retraction checks and a cite guard, results-to-macros sync with stale-number audits and a per-figure reproduction table, paper-vs-code settings and claim checks, figure checks at printed size, a compile-and-fix loop, review and rebuttal loops, and arXiv packaging with HTML checks. Plus TikZ, equations, tables, talks, posters, 22 document templates (CVs, theses, exams), conversion and PDF finishing.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Show AgenTeX's ambient UI: a one-time welcome after install, a small animation above the prompt while AgenTeX checks run, a status line while a check fails, and a toast when one starts failing. /agentex opens the paper health pane either way.
